metadata.description: Reusable agent skills for exam restoration, GitHub network diagnostics, knowledge-point explainer videos, AI trending and Hacker News digests, Bilibili publishing, and plugin releases.

plugins.name: yobdcdoll-skills
plugins.description: All seven skills bundled: exam restoration, GitHub IP diagnostics, knowledge-point explainer videos, AI trending digests, Hacker News digests, Bilibili publishing, and one-command plugin releases.

plugins.name: exam-clean
plugins.description: Restore photographed exams into clean, printable PDFs without handwritten answers.

plugins.name: update-github-hosts
plugins.description: Diagnose, update, and verify GitHub IP mappings in macOS /etc/hosts.

plugins.name: gen-knowledge-video
plugins.description: Turn any knowledge point or skill into a self-study explainer video with narration, cue-aligned visuals, and subtitles.

plugins.name: biliup
plugins.description: Upload, inspect, and manage Bilibili videos with the biliup CLI, including metadata, status checks, and rate-limit handling.

plugins.name: release-plugin
plugins.description: Commit, push, and update the installed Claude Code plugin so the latest skills take effect.

plugins.name: github-ai-trending
plugins.description: Fetch GitHub Trending daily and weekly lists, filter AI/ML repositories, and emit Markdown or JSON for any agent to deliver.

plugins.name: hackernews-daily
plugins.description: Fetch Hacker News daily and weekly top stories, optionally generate Chinese summaries, and emit Markdown or JSON for any agent to deliver.
